name: Totarol
description: Totarol (CAS 511-15-9 ) is a naturally derived diterpenoid phenol extracted primarily from the heartwood of Podocarpus totara. It functions as a potent antimicrobial and antioxidant active. This compound is used in preservation systems and bioactive formulations across personal care and pharmaceutical development. In cosmetic formulations, it is incorporated as a natural preservative booster. It is effective against gram-positive bacteria and offers an alternative to synthetic biocides in clean-label product lines. Skincare brands use it in creams, serums, and deodorant formulations. It is ideal where broad-spectrum antimicrobial activity is required alongside antioxidant protection. Pharmaceutical researchers apply it in topical and oral care preparations targeting bacterial biofilm disruption. It is particularly useful in anti-acne and anti-plaque product development. Its antioxidant capacity also supports stability in lipid-rich formulations, helping extend shelf life in oil-based personal care products. The product is typically supplied as a fine powder or resinous solid, with purity grades commonly ranging from 95% upward for cosmetic and research applications. Standardized botanical extracts are also available. These extracts contain defined concentrations for formulators seeking a diluted, easier-to-handle format. Buyers should confirm specification documentation, including HPLC-verified purity and botanical sourcing details. This is essential when evaluating suppliers for regulated end-use applications.
